title: eludite.editor.find_references output
description: The Find All References window's contents. From the UI thread this is the state right after the request was sent, usually `loading`; from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the answer.

path.description: The document the search started in.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server (or reading the lines of the results); `done`: the window shows the results; `failed`: the request failed.

symbol.description: The name searched for, as the window's title shows it.

references.description: The references in display order (project, then file, then position); at most 1000.

project.description: The project the file belongs to, as Workspace names it; absent for a file outside the solution.

text.description: The line's text, without leading and trailing white space.
